Configuring the retry policy

The client retries failed requests with exponential backoff. You can change how many attempts it makes and how long it waits between them when you create the client.

Set the attempts option to limit retries, and the delay option to control the first wait in milliseconds. Each later wait doubles.

const client = createClient({
  attempts: 4,
  delay: 250,
});

Only idempotent requests are retried by default. To retry a POST, mark it explicitly.

await client.post("/orders", body, { retry: true });

Errors that are not temporary, such as a 404, are never retried.
